title: Constructive CLM-001B — Latent Coordinate Discovery under Superposition

parent.interpretation: G1a supported: addressable reusable Cell formation works in the registered singleton-exposure world. 001B removes the singleton prototype scaffold.

decision_question: Can reusable latent Cell keys/effects be recovered from continual pair superpositions when no training transaction ever presents a hidden factor alone, and can the recovered Cells address unseen pair and triple compositions from x alone?

world.heldout_pair_design: seeded perfect matching: 3 of 15 pair types are never shown in training
world.training_support: exactly two hidden factors per transaction; no singleton or triple exposure
world.heldout_pair_test: 3 completely unseen pair types with unequal random convex weights in [0.25, 0.75]
world.heldout_triple_test: all 20 triples, never shown in training, with random positive convex weights

learner.stage_1: online x/y transaction means are clustered into stable mixture prototypes; learner sees no factor or pair identity
learner.stage_2: pairwise prototype distances are split into near/far classes by deterministic 1D two-means
learner.stage_3: near-distance graph is treated as the learned overlap graph; maximal largest cliques become latent star candidates
learner.stage_4: each mixture prototype must belong to exactly two learned stars; the resulting incidence matrix B is solved by least squares P = B D for latent joint Cell state D
learner.cell_state: split recovered joint atom into context read key and effect value
learner.inference: enumerate supports of size <=3 and solve x-only nonnegative simplex least squares; predicted effect is the same coefficient mixture of Cell values

controls.transaction_memory: nearest observed training mixture prototype; cannot synthesize a latent unseen composition
controls.shuffled_effect_address: preserve learned context prototypes but derange associated effect prototypes before nearest-prototype prediction
controls.purpose: distinguish latent reusable Cell recovery from transaction memorization or an arbitrary x/effect association

interpretation.positive: Within the registered relational pair-superposition family, singleton exposure is not necessary: repeated overlap structure can identify latent reusable Cell keys/effects, and x-only inference can synthesize unseen pairs/triples. This supports G1b under the registered scaffold and opens long-horizon growth-law validation.
interpretation.negative: The registered relational mechanism does not reliably recover latent Cells without singleton exposure. Do not proceed by assuming 001's prototype formation generalizes to entangled mixtures.
not_established: certificate integration with learned latent coordinates
